description: The regional health agency lists oncology orientation centres within the Puglia oncology network and their reference hospitals. The description identifies their territorial distribution and roles in initial patient admission, referral and continuity of care. CSV, GeoJSON and JSON are listed as complementary formats. Actual centre locations, patient pathways, throughput, staffing and capacity were not read. Institutional roles are source statements, not verified operational performance. Coverage is Puglia, Italy. The licence declared by native metadata is CC-BY-4.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related resources may overlap this inventory or time period, but no further exact relationship is established by the inspected metadata.
